sources.inspection: Full native1202x850modern photograph inspected. Main hall has orange grooved double eaves, strong red swallowtail ends, central seven-tier pagoda and paired gold cylinders; blue/green ridge bands, gray cylindrical/coiled-dragon columns, dark wood lattice openings and a raised granite DanChi platform with flanking stairs. Lower side wings visible. Creator’s overlaid color swatches obscure some central openings; those swatches, tourists/calligraphy and source pixels are not reproduced. The catalog1879creation field describes temple history, not a claimed photograph date.

limits: One public-domain/CC0 image does not photograph every surface. Primary architecture facts and native map carry the remainder of the agreed approximate exterior.
Color swatches obscure small central openings; roof curvature, hidden elevations, repetitive side windows, fine ceramic carving and bridge/enclosure details remain interpretations.
